test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: According to a certain logic, 23 is related to 45. Following the same logic, 54 is related to 76. Following the same logic, 67 is related to which of the following?
solution:
**Logic: Second no. = [First no. + 22]**

**(1)** 23 is related to 45 →

⇒ [23 + 22] = 45

**(2)** 54 is related to 76 →

⇒ [54 + 22] = 76&l
